evidence.detail: The class contains only two static integer predicates: one admits login privilege value 2; the other admits exactly 2, 26, 204 and 205.
Client.cT is populated directly from the successful login-response stream before the live client session is initialized, fixing the predicate input as server-supplied login privilege/access state.

Object/item/NPC menu construction uses these predicates only on debug-definition presentation paths. One exact string-concat recipe appends '@gre@(@cya@ID: @whi@<id>@gre@)' to Examine text, while ItemDefinition conditionally decorates definition names with IDs under the narrower predicate.

The class owns no role labels, permission mutation, authentication logic or gameplay entitlement checks; it only decides whether definition-ID debug presentation is exposed for particular login privilege values.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the login-privilege predicates controlling definition-ID debug/examine presentation. Specific staff/rank titles for values 2/26/204/205 are intentionally not invented.
